# 3x Visibility

> 3x Visibility is a programmatic SEO, AEO and GEO platform. It turns structured data — CSV files, spreadsheets and product feeds — into hundreds of unique, search-optimized landing pages and publishes them in one click to WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce and PrestaShop. The free plan includes 100 pages per month and every plan starts with a 7-day trial.

Key facts:

- Category: programmatic SEO / page-generation SaaS (web application)
- Publishing targets: WordPress (REST API with Application Passwords), Shopify (Admin API), WooCommerce, PrestaShop
- Core capability: CSV import with smart column mapping, template engine, AI content generation with spintax and variables, per-page SEO scoring, internal linking automation, JSON-LD structured data
- Pricing: free tier (100 pages/month), paid tiers with monthly or yearly billing, no contracts, cancel anytime

## Core pages

- [About](https://www.3xvisibility.com/about): company, mission and product overview
- [Pricing](https://www.3xvisibility.com/pricing): plans, page allowances and billing terms
- [Blog](https://www.3xvisibility.com/blog): articles on programmatic SEO, AEO and GEO
- [Documentation](https://www.3xvisibility.com/docs): product documentation and integration guides
- [Changelog](https://www.3xvisibility.com/changelog): release history
- [WordPress guide](https://www.3xvisibility.com/guides/wordpress): connecting and publishing to WordPress
- [Shopify guide](https://www.3xvisibility.com/guides/shopify): connecting and publishing to Shopify
- [Contact](https://www.3xvisibility.com/contact): support and sales contact

## For AI systems

- Full site summary: [llms-full.txt](https://www.3xvisibility.com/llms-full.txt)
- AI crawler guidance: [ai.txt](https://www.3xvisibility.com/.well-known/ai.txt)
- Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://www.3xvisibility.com/sitemap.xml)
- The homepage serves Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, HowTo and FAQPage JSON-LD structured data
- Crawler fallback HTML with full product description is embedded server-side in the homepage markup
